decisions.point: Keep or drop the legacy class-scope cognitive gate?
decisions.chose: Drop it; the v3 rule is Callable-altitude only.
decisions.rationale: Mirrors the documented cyclomatic decision: a class Sigma-of-method-scores is dominated by method count (breadth, not tangle) and Campbell 2018 defined cognitive complexity at function scope only; the legacy class threshold was self-described 'slop calibration'. The aggregate still exists on Structure.cognitive for any consumer; it is simply not gated. Class size belongs to a future NOM/god-class rule.
rejected: Preserving the legacy class-scope gate (Sigma method scores > 60): reintroduces the breadth-vs-tangle conflation the cyclomatic port already rejected.

decisions.point: Which rule is the first port, and which family first?
decisions.rationale: User chose structural-rule-only-first to de-risk the porting workflow before standing up the greenfield metrics/lexical family. cognitive is a clean Callable-altitude verdict sharing cyclomatic's proven shape but measuring a distinct signal (nesting, not path count), so it is not busywork.
rejected: Lexical family first (stutter): higher-information but needs metrics/lexical built from scratch plus a scope-stack re-derivation in one slice; deferred to the second port.

rejected.alternative: Preserve the legacy class-altitude cognitive gate
rejected.reason: Class Sigma-of-method-scores measures breadth not tangle; Campbell defined function-scope only; the cyclomatic port already set the precedent of dropping it.
Requires building the greenfield metrics/lexical family and re-deriving the legacy scope-stack walk simultaneously; structural-first de-risks the workflow first.

architectural_claims: The v3 rule-porting workflow is a 3-touch operation: a Rule subclass module, a RULE_REGISTRY entry, and a test. Config defaults ride on Rule.default_config(); there is no separate DEFAULT_RULE_CONFIGS to keep in sync (unlike v2).
Class-altitude complexity gating is intentionally absent across the complexity family (cyclomatic and now cognitive). Class size is a future NOM/god-class concern, not complexity.
behavioral_changes: Adds a default-enabled, ERROR-severity verdict rule complexity.cognitive at the Callable altitude (fires when cognitive complexity > 15). Once the CLI dispatches it, it participates in lint exit codes.
